final: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM group_stats) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio), SUM(g.order_count), AVG(g.order_count - a.avg_count) FROM group_stats AS g CROSS JOIN group_avg AS a WHERE g.order_count > a.avg_count
